messages.subject: Whitcombe v Sutherland Logistics — tribunal listing
messages.plaintextBody:
Lesley,

Unrelated to the banking work — a quick update on the Whitcombe unfair dismissal claim. The tribunal has listed the final hearing for the week of 14 September (3 days) at Birmingham. We'll need to finalise the witness statements (Diane and Mark Tennant) over the summer and update the schedule of loss. I'll send a separate note on without-prejudice options.

No action needed today — just so it's on your radar alongside everything else.

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
